name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx multisite web server with SSL termination, security hardening, and per-vhost configuration. Serves three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with fail2ban, UFW firewall, SSH hardening, and kernel sysctl tuning.

name: cache
description: Caching layer that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same host. Applies a post-install config-patching workaround to strip incompatible directives from the generated Redis configuration before enabling the service.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python application provisioner that deploys a FastAPI application from a public GitHub repository with a PostgreSQL backend. Configures a Python virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user, a .env credentials file, and a systemd unit for the uvicorn application server.
